title: PAT-031: Fixtures that hold app.cms_rpc for the whole transaction hide a read that forgets it (2026-10-22)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.8 (six instances of a stub, fixture or test environment supplying the hoped-for context: S07/08 capability header, S12 nil-UUID probe, dec208 RLS flag held by fixtures, linked-scan resolver flag caught by its own context-cleared test, jsdom module model hiding the browser cache of a failed dynamic import, jsdom tests passing while a committed-but-unanswered governed decision was drawn as retryable)
- **Context**: Any new SECURITY DEFINER entry point (platform_api wrapper, service_role RPC, trigger) over forced-RLS cms_ tables; any browser behaviour that depends on the real module loader, hydration timing or network order.
- **Pattern**: Every entry point needs a context-cleared test: clear app.cms_rpc, call as the real caller role, assert real non-zero rows and that the caller value is restored, plus a negative control (model phase_02_slice_12_fix_template_reads_rpc_context.sql). A suite whose fixtures set the flag globally proves nothing about the entry point. Root scan: grep WIP entry points for set_config(app.cms_rpc). For the web, a real-Chrome real-route spec is the proof; jsdom does not model the module map, hydration or chunk loading.
- **Source**: Review V3 F-1 (dec208 zeros under forced RLS, 78/78 green); 2026-10-23 governed real-route spec T5/T6 (failed dynamic import cached by Chrome; lost answer UI) while jsdom suites passed.

title: PAT-034: Playwright empties test-results/ at start, so evidence inputs written there vanish (2026-10-24)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.5
- **Context**: Any script that writes Vitest/pgTAP/race output for a later collect step and also runs Playwright with the default outputDir.
- **Pattern**: Write every collected input outside test-results/ (or pass Playwright --output=<own dir>, as run-plan-lib.mjs does). Copy a report whose file name is semantic (vitest-evidence-s09.json) before any Playwright run. List the input directory just before the collect step.
- **Source**: run-final-evidence.sh 2026-10-23: the Slice 09 collect step failed ENOENT; only the last Playwright JSON survived. Fixed by evidence/run-s09-evidence.sh.

title: PAT-035: A green evidence runner is not a green ledger guard; run the guards right after the receipts (2026-10-24)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.5
- **Context**: run-slice-evidence.mjs reports PASSED per step and writes receipts, but it does not evaluate the ledger guard (citation titles that no longer exist, duplicated test identities).
- **Pattern**: After every receipts run, run the slice evidence guard and the documentation-boundaries test before anything else depends on the result. Before the run, check that every cited title still exists and that no cited file repeats a full test name (it.each without per-case interpolation).
- **Source**: 2026-10-24 final evidence: SLICE12/11 runners all PASS, then the guards found 23 and 7 problems (renamed pgTAP titles, Slice 12 retitling S11 preflight tests, 21 duplicated it.each names).

title: DEC-226: Slice 12 ledger evidence policy for re-citation (2026-10-24)
text:
- **Problem**: Refutation review c found the four re-citation lanes applying five evidence questions inconsistently; the Slice 12 ledger needs one rule per question before the proposals are applied.
- **Options considered**: (A) permissive — labels, named-role grants, component+loader tests, stubbed tokens and include-file identities count; (B) strict, per question, as below.
- **Decision**: B (root implementation decision; owner may override). (1) A declared `tier_N` label or SLO class never proves a "Tier N p95 < X" target; that needs a measurement (hosted evidence or a bench). (2) "EXECUTE revoked from every other role" needs an owner-only ACL assertion (proacl), not four named-role checks. (3) "Consumed by X at /app/…" needs page-level behaviour (an Astro render test or a real-route Playwright spec); component and loader tests alone do not prove the page mounts it; source-text tests never count. (4) A Worker mapping test with a stubbed token proves a route clause only if the database really raises that token on that operation (pgTAP evidence of the producer) — otherwise it is PAT-031. (5) A computed pgTAP description is cited under the entrypoint `.sql` that owns it, never the `.sqlinc`.
- **Downstream**: AC-127/162/168/174/180 stay partial (p95 unmeasured); ACL and page-mount clauses become test gaps; the apply of `recite/*-proposals.json` follows these rules.
- **Reversibility**: High (ledger citations only).

title: DEC-227: Slice 12 spec-versus-code cleanup from the re-citation lanes (2026-10-24)
text:
- **Problem**: The re-citation lanes and refutations found Slice 12 acceptance criteria and BE03c lines that contradict the code and, in most cases, another BE03c or BE03b statement (research: docs/handoffs/2026-10-22-claude-s12/recite/spec-questions.md Q1-Q9).
- **Options considered**: per item, amend the spec to match the code and the governing statement, or change the code to match the outlier statement.
- **Decision**: root decision, owner may override, no code change: (Q1) CMS-03C-02 body revisionId/patternId fail 422 like every other body id (AC-026 "400/404" -> "422/404"); (Q3) AC-062 hidden target is the uniform 422 per DEC-195/D11; (Q4) CMS-03C-17 is a scoped list: hidden owner scope 404, no matching vocabulary an empty page (AC-132/134); (Q5) the CMS-03C-18 caller is cms_act_taxonomy_term through cms_term_overlap_check and the activation preflight reads the domain registry provider_state (AC-138/141); (Q6) CMS-03C-09 has no separate 422 preflight failure, the template/pattern preflight inputs are in the step (4) frozen status (AC-086); (Q8) AC-274 invalid provider response 502, unavailable 503, deadline 504; (Q9) CMS-03C-08 create/revoke keep the review version and state except the 03b DEC-161 counted-approval revoke invalidation (AC-079). Q2 (AC-055 unsupported locale on the CMS-03C-04 write) is an owner question; Q7 (AC-105 node pointers) is an implementation gap.
- **Downstream**: BE03c rows 193, 382, 1410, 1419, 1479 step (5), 1656, 222, 1718 + changelog (done); tracker/phase-2/ledger texts of AC-026, 062, 079, 086, 132, 134, 138, 141, 274 follow after the ledger apply lane.
- **Reversibility**: High.

title: DEC-228: CMS-03C-12 cycle, depth and node-count refusals point at the offending request node (2026-10-24)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c 1525 and FE03 885 put the CMS-03C-12 blockTree refusals at the offending node pointer `/blockTree/{i}(/children/{j})*` and render them inline at the node, but the SQL raises pattern_cycle, pattern_depth_exceeded and pattern_nodes_exceeded with the root pointer `/blockTree`, and the spec never says which node is offending.
- **Options considered**: (A) keep the root pointer and amend FE03/BE03c; (B) point at a defined offending node per refusal.
- **Decision**: B (root implementation decision; owner may override). Depth: the first request node in preorder whose level is 9. Node count: the request node whose expansion first takes the expanded node total past 512 (a block node or a nested pattern node). Cycle: the nested `pattern` node whose lineage closes the cycle. The pointer is the request path of that node; the refusal tokens and statuses are unchanged.
- **Downstream**: WIP node-pointers migration (anchored patch of cms_create_pattern_version), Worker relay, CmsPatternVersionDesigner inline error; BE03c field matrix CMS-03C-12 blockTree row gains the rule; P2-S12-AC-105 clause on the node path becomes provable.
- **Reversibility**: High.
